headline: ARAFURA BREAKS GROUND ON NOLANS — AUSTRALIA'S FIRST INTEGRATED RARE EARTHS MINE STARTS BUILD WITH A$1.2B GOVERNMENT BACKING
snippet: Construction began October 8 at Arafura Rare Earths' Nolans project in Australia's Northern Territory, 135 km north of Alice Springs, backed by approximately A$1.2 billion (US$850 million) in federal government investment. The NT government describes it as only the third fully integrated rare earths ore-to-oxide operation outside mainland China — producing neodymium-praseodymium oxide critical to EV motors and wind turbines — with first production targeted for mid-2029.

headline: HOT CHILI DRILLS 112M AT 0.47% CUEQ AT LA VERDE — BROAD NEAR-SURFACE PORPHYRY KEEPS GROWING IN CHILE'S ATACAMA REGION
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Hot Chili (TSXV: HCH)
snippet: Hot Chili (TSXV/ASX: HCH) released new drill results from La Verde, its emerging copper-gold porphyry discovery in Chile, returning 112 metres averaging 0.47% CuEq from 42 metres depth including a 26-metre core at 0.70% CuEq from 62 metres. The broad, shallow intercepts continue expanding La Verde's footprint 30 km south of the company's existing 798 Mt Costa Fuego copper-gold resource, with RC drilling also targeting higher-grade near-surface zones.

headline: DPM METALS Q3 2026: 53 KOZ GOLD, 934 KOZ SILVER — ELEVENTH STRAIGHT YEAR ON TRACK FOR ANNUAL GUIDANCE
source_name: Junior Mining Network / DPM Metals (TSX: DPM)
snippet: DPM Metals (TSX: DPM) reported preliminary Q3 2026 production of approximately 53,000 ounces of gold and 934,000 ounces of silver across its Chelopech, Ada Tepe, and Vareš operations, with management confirming the company is on pace to achieve the high end of its 2026 full-year guidance — extending its streak of meeting annual production targets to 11 consecutive years.

headline: GREAT SOUTHERN MINING WRAPS GOLD FIELDS-BACKED MT DILLON PROGRAM — BOTH HOLES EXCEED PLANNED DEPTH, ASSAYS LATE OCTOBER
snippet: Great Southern Mining (ASX: GSN) announced completion of its Gold Fields-funded diamond drilling program at Mt Dillon in north Queensland, with two holes totalling 1,534 metres — both extending well past planned depths — logging geological features consistent with an intermediate epithermal gold system. Assays are expected in late October to early November; the best prior result at the property was 9 metres at 3.36 g/t gold from 127 metres.

headline: SPAC BETS $318M ON SWEDEN URANIUM — DIGITAL ASSET ACQUISITION MERGES WITH TITAN STRATEGICS TO REVIVE RANSTAD DISTRICT
source_name: SEC 8-K / Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: DAAQ)
snippet: Digital Asset Acquisition Corp. (Nasdaq: DAAQ) signed a merger agreement on October 7 with Titan Strategics Holdings, whose Swedish subsidiary holds 207 km² of exploration permits covering the Billingen uranium district — site of the former Ranstad mine, Sweden's only uranium producer from 1965-1969. The combined company will rebrand as Renaissance Nuclear, Inc. and is backed by 242 historical drill holes averaging approximately 350 ppm U3O8; no current NI 43-101 resource exists and technical reports should be reviewed with that in mind.

headline: ALTIUS RAISES TNR GOLD STAKE TO 12.7%, ENTERS EXCLUSIVITY FOR FULL BUYOUT — LITHIUM ROYALTY JUNIOR IN PLAY
snippet: Altius Minerals (TSX: ALS) filed an early warning report on October 6 disclosing it had increased its TNR Gold (TSXV: TNR) stake to 12.7% through open-market purchases at C$0.23 per share and entered an exclusivity arrangement toward a potential full acquisition. TNR holds royalties on the Mariana lithium brine project in Argentina, making this a direct play on the battery metals royalty segment that Altius has been building out.

headline: GOLD TESTS 2-WEEK LOW AT $4,100-$4,135 AS DOLLAR PUSHES TOWARD 102 — 78% ODDS FED HOLDS IN OCTOBER
snippet: Gold retreated to a two-week low in the $4,100-$4,135 per ounce range as the US dollar index strengthened toward 102 and Treasury yields climbed, reducing the appeal of the non-yielding metal even as markets priced an approximately 78% probability of a Fed rate hold in October. Despite the pullback, gold gained roughly 4% over Q3 2026 and central-bank buying plus ETF inflows have established the $4,100-$4,200 zone as a near-term support floor that analysts are watching closely.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD IN THE "CHAMPIONS BUY ZONE" AT $3,941-$4,200 — GDX BULL FLAG TARGETS $170-200, MINERS UP 9% IN OCTOBER
snippet: In his October 7 GoldSeek commentary, Stewart Thomson argues that gold's pullback into the $3,941-$4,200 range represents a high-quality accumulation zone, noting that the GDX gold miners ETF has formed a textbook weekly bull flag with a measured target of $170-$200. Thomson highlights that GDX had already gained 9.2% month-to-date and argues that rising rates, while near-term headwinds, historically coexist with strong gold mining equity performance when they reflect reflation rather than recession risk.
